主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. filed an amendment to its Annual Report on Form 40-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2020, to correct the number of outstanding Class A and Class B Limited Voting Shares and a typographical error in the date included in the consent of Deloitte LLP. The amendment includes a cover page, explanatory note, updated Exhibit Index, updated consent of Deloitte, certifications of officers under the Sarbanes-Oxley Act, and a signature page.
